def factor_volume_breakout(df):
    """Volume breakout: ratio of recent max volume to wider max volume."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    vol_short_max = df_copy["volume"].rolling(window=10, min_periods=10).max()
    vol_long_max = df_copy["volume"].rolling(window=50, min_periods=50).max()
    ratio = vol_short_max / vol_long_max.replace(0, np.nan)
    df_copy["factor_volume_breakout"] = ratio
    return df_copy["factor_volume_breakout"]
description: Captures volume abnormality by comparing recent maximum volume (10-day) to a longer-term maximum (50-day). A high ratio indicates that the recent volume surge is approaching or exceeding historical extremes, signaling heightened attention or potential breakout. This temporal structure contrasts short-term peaks against the stock's own volume history.
